title: passavant-ee.com
description: German engineering company Passavant Energy & Environment GmbH, which builds wastewater treatment plants with German and Swiss taxpayer money (KfW, SECO), is in reality controlled by Dubai-based conglomerate Drake & Scull International PJSC and through it finances operations in Iraq. Internal debit notes from Drake & Scull Oil & Gas — Iraq Branch show that employees of the Iraqi division flew to Muscat (Oman) and stayed at hotels billed to Passavant Frankfurt, with the company's accounting department at Hahnstraße 31-35 approving those charges for payment. Employee Serikan Kire
